HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8..
   D. Use Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8. to insult classmates of other faiths.
